scope: Six source reviews: three larger-position analyses, two incomplete-board information requests, and one middlegame king hunt outside endgame scope. No new verified study or inferred position. Original v3 unchanged.

MUrT0Ke9goQ.notes: All 69 saved states and captions reviewed. Kasparov/Topalov king-hunt tactics eventually reach a genuine queen-versus-rook endgame. The final source diagram still contains eleven pieces: White Kc1/Qa7/f4/g3/h2 against Black Ke1/Rd2/c3/f5/g6/h7. Source evidence is available.
MUrT0Ke9goQ.analysis_required: Reconstruct the full larger-position Rd4/Re7 sacrifice sequence and selected defenses, or explicitly scope a later queen-versus-rook conversion. Verify Bf1/Rd2/Rd7/Rxd7/Bxc4, the subsequent queen/rook captures and the remaining passed c-pawn without dropping spare pawns to fit tablebases. Distinguish the narrated game continuation from illustrative mate sidelines and verify outcomes using supported larger-position analysis; an engine estimate is not an exact tablebase proof.

OMnK1bs9Iks.notes: Reviewed all three accepted images, the complete flagged montage, and five native flagged crops (1,68,100,132,165). Both accepted and flagged crops omit the left side of this angled physical board. Captions describe Qc2, a reverse queen ladder and Rh2+, but the missing squares cannot be declared empty or reconstructed from narration alone. No matching local uncropped raw video/frame was found with ignored files included in search.
information_needed: Provide an uncropped image showing all eight files and ranks, or the original local video, or authoritative FEN/PGN with side to move for the reverse queen-ladder composition. The current physical-board crops omit the left-side files; include every spare pawn and both kings.

Dx1fhDf0gxk.notes: All 89 saved states and narration reviewed. This opening-to-endgame game includes an actual rook ending, passed b-pawn and king activation, so it remains an endgame candidate. The final illustrated position still has ten pieces: White Kc5/Ra7/b6/c4/f2/h3 against Black Kb7/Rf7/g7/g5. No source gap identified.
Dx1fhDf0gxk.analysis_required: Reconstruct the larger rook ending after ...c4 and the capture/rook-lift sequence that preserves the passed b-pawn. Check b6/Rb7/Rb5+, the king approach and subsequent pawn collection while retaining c4/f2/h3/g7/g5 and both rooks. Separate actual game moves from the earlier long analytical opening sidelines; 1fps snapshots are not a complete PGN. Larger-position outcome analysis is required before a verified label.

F2zH_DukCBg.notes: All 39 saved states and narration reviewed. The queenless overload sequence Be3/Rd1/Rf1/Rxd1 and the advancing e-pawn are visible, but retain a substantial number of pawns and minor pieces. The narrator explicitly says the friendly game ending was not recorded and is not remembered. That limits source continuation; it does not erase the available starting diagrams.
F2zH_DukCBg.analysis_required: Reconstruct the complete queenless setup and independently verify the bishop/rook overload sacrifice, the pinned bishop, e3/e2 and ...Ne5 rather than treating the source claim of an unstoppable pawn as proof. Preserve all white/black queenside and kingside pawns, Nb1/Nc6 and Ra1/Rd1. The narrated game stops after Ne5; any later conversion must be explicitly independent, checked with larger-position analysis, and must not be attributed to the missing original game ending.

CxVXJaDzU7g.notes: All 58 saved states and narration reviewed. This is a middlegame king hunt from a developed position: the bishop/knight offers, ...e5+, ...Bg4+, ...Bh4, queen invasion and final ...Qg6 mate. Queens, rooks, minor pieces and many pawns remain throughout. No worked endgame position or conversion is presented. It remains discoverable as a channel tactic, outside the endgame-study scope.

dywWNMdY6JA.notes: All 59 saved digital-board crops and narration reviewed, including native image 22. The crops show only seven board rows above the caption band. The white king cannot be located in the initial rook-sacrifice setup; a king appears in the later simplified diagram, which does not establish its earlier square. There are no flagged alternatives and no matching local uncropped video/raw frames were found. No legal FEN was inferred from the narrator’s king-control claim.
